title: Congresswoman Terri Sewell's Annual Job Fair in Selma
text:
The job fair is open to the public and free of charge. Attendees are encouraged to dress professionally or in business casual attire, bring multiple copies of their resumes, and be prepared to speak with employers throughout the day.
Residents looking for a new job, a career change, or workforce training will have the opportunity to connect with dozens of employers this week as Congresswoman Terri Sewell brings her annual job fair back to her hometown of Selma.
The 15th Annual Job Fair will be held on Thursday, August 6, from 10 a.m. until 2 p.m. at Wallace Community College Selma, where more than 75 employers representing 12 industries are expected to meet with job seekers from across Alabama's Black Belt. Congresswoman Terri Sewell has been a priority since she first took office, creating opportunities for people in Alabama's 7th Congressional District by helping connect them with great opportunities, including great jobs and good-paying jobs
